papers.title: HEARTS: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning on Health Time Series
papers.what: A benchmark of 110 tasks over 16 health datasets and 20 signal types showing that 14 current LLMs underperform specialized models and degrade as temporal reasoning steps grow.
papers.builds_on: TS-Agent (Liu 2025, I2CIT4I7); LLMs are Few-Shot Health Learners (Liu 2023, JX3X3KH5); ChatTS (Xie 2025, VSCNJG5J); LLMs for Time Series Survey (Zhang 2024, N2JLZBY3)

papers.title: Learning Transferable Sensor Models via Language-Informed Pretraining (SLIP)
papers.what: A sensor encoder pretrained with contrastive signal-language alignment plus captioning and a variable-resolution patch embedder, reaching 77.14% linear-probe accuracy across 11 datasets while transferring across sensor configurations.
papers.builds_on: Sensor2Text (Chen 2024, ELYUE3NF); SSL for HAR (Yuan 2024, RTMH75VW); Time-LLM (Jin 2024, MKICLA63)

papers.title: EASE-TTT: Evidence-Aligned Selective Test-Time Training for Long-Context Question Answering
papers.what: A test-time training method that turns retrieved evidence into a soft attention target to adapt query-side parameters, giving the best macro-average over full-context, retrieval-only, and query-only TTT baselines on six LongBench QA tasks.
papers.builds_on: TTT Layers (Sun 2024, JEGI4IS7); TTT for Abstract Reasoning (Akyurek 2024, W7RPRTCH)

papers.title: FEEL: Quantifying Heterogeneity in Physiological Signals for Generalizable Emotion Recognition
papers.what: A cross-dataset benchmark of emotion recognition from EDA and PPG over 19 datasets and 16 models, finding contrastive signal-language models score highest but handcrafted features still beat raw-signal models under noise.
papers.builds_on: Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF); SSL for HAR (Yuan 2024, RTMH75VW); HeAR (Baur 2024, 3LA8GNCU)
